board: Adafruit GA1A12S202 Log-scale Analog Light Sensor (product ID 1384)
reason: Modelled as an analog-sensor whose slider is log10(lux): datasheet Io = 10 x log10(Ev) uA into the board's 68 kOhm load gives V = 0.68 V per decade (0-4.7 decades -> 0-3.196 V), and the driver computes lux = 10^(V/0.68); pins VCC, OUT, GND per Adafruit Fritzing part. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico (L=1000lx), with footprint, design checks and DRC clean.
breakoutPinoutSource: Adafruit Fritzing-Library parts/Adafruit GA1A1S202WP.fzpz (breadboard silkscreen VCC, OUT, GND left to right) and adafruit.com/product/1384 (Vin 2.3-6 V, 68K load resistor OUT to GND)
